articles.title: Kansas City blow: Travis Kelce ankle injury takes worrying turn before Broncos game
articles.standfirst: Travis Kelce’s injury scare is raising concerns in Kansas City as the Chiefs prepare for a crucial AFC West showdown against the Broncos.
articles.summary: Travis Kelce’s injury scare is raising concerns in Kansas City as the Chiefs prepare for a crucial AFC West showdown against the Broncos.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs are trying to move past their first loss of the season, a painful 20-3 defeat to the defending Super Bowl champions, the Seattle Seahawks , in a game in which the offense managed just three points.

However, concerns grew in Kansas City ahead of another key AFC West matchup against the Denver Broncos . The team reported that Travis Kelce returned to the injury report after limited participation in Thursday’s practice due to an ankle issue.

The situation drew attention because just one day earlier the future Hall of Famer had practiced without restrictions. While it is not a new injury, it serves as a reminder that the veteran tight end continues to deal with physical discomfort.

In addition to Kelce , Rashee Rice , L’Jarius Sneed , and Omarr Norman-Lott also practiced on a limited basis, while cornerback Mansoor Delane did not practice due to a shoulder injury.

The injury that continues to bother Kelce

The ankle problem originated in the first quarter of the Chiefs’ 22-6 victory over the Los Angeles Chargers on October 18 .

After catching a screen pass, Kelce was brought down by linebacker Daiyan Henley with a hip-drop tackle. On the play, the defender’s shoulder struck the tight end’s right ankle directly.

Kelce briefly left the field limping while being attended to by the medical staff, who immobilized and taped the joint. Despite the hit, he returned to the game and finished with four receptions for 53 yards.

After the contest, Andy Reid downplayed the situation, explaining that Kelce had simply “tweaked his ankle.” Former NFL doctor David Chao later analyzed the play and described it as a mild high eversion sprain, an injury that typically allows a player to compete when the ankle is properly stabilized.

Kelce played last week against Seattle despite limited practice for several days, though his production again suffered. He finished with four catches for 44 yards in the loss to the Seahawks — only the second time this season he has failed to surpass 50 receiving yards.

Even so, he tied Noah Gray for the team lead in receiving yards and reached another historic milestone by surpassing Marvin Harrison and Cris Carter to move into fifth place on the NFL’s all-time receptions list.

Will he be available against Denver?

Kelce remains on the official injury report, and his final status will be determined after Friday’s practice.

For now, all indications suggest he will once again be available to face the Broncos, just as he was last week against Seattle.

In the first meeting of the season against Denver, the veteran posted 71 receiving yards , and the Chiefs hope to have their primary offensive weapon available in a game that could shape the race for the AFC West.

Kansas City enters the matchup at 5-1 , just one game ahead of the 5-2 Broncos, giving the contest significant weight in the battle for the top of the division.

Kelce approaches the game with a career total of 1,104 receptions, 13,345 receiving yards, and 84 touchdowns in the regular season. In 2026 he has recorded 24 catches for 343 yards and two scores.

A three-time Super Bowl champion, 11-time Pro Bowler, and four-time All-Pro, Kelce also holds the tight end records for most 1,000-yard seasons (7) and most receiving yards in a single season (1,416 in 2020).

Off the field, the tight end married Taylor Swift on July 3 at Madison Square Garden. The singer was present at Arrowhead Stadium when Kelce suffered the ankle scare against the Chargers, though she has not made any public comments about the injury since.

articles.title: "Dumbest thing I've ever seen": Jason and Travis Kelce slam NFL referees
articles.standfirst: The Kelce brothers have questioned the officials' decision to penalise New York Giants running back Cam Skattebo after a collision with Houston Texans safety M.J. Stewart
articles.summary: The Kelce brothers have questioned the officials' decision to penalise New York Giants running back Cam Skattebo after a collision with Houston Texans safety M.J. Stewart
articles.body:
J ason and Travis Kelce have joined the growing criticism of NFL officials after a controversial call against New York Giants running back Cam Skattebo during the team's Week 7 victory over the Houston Texans .

The incident became a talking point on the latest episode of the brothers' New Heights podcast, where the former Philadelphia Eagles centre and Kansas City Chiefs tight end discussed the unnecessary roughness penalty handed to Skattebo .

The Giants running back was penalised in the first quarter after lowering his helmet into Texans safety M.J. Stewart while attempting to gain additional yards. Officials ruled that he had initiated contact with the crown of his helmet, resulting in a 15-yard penalty and wiping out a seven-yard gain.

Travis admitted that he struggled to understand precisely what the officials had seen.

“I just don’t get it, man,” the Chiefs tight end said. “… Was it the crown of the helmet thing? Had to be, right?”

Jason was considerably less restrained in his response, questioning the decision and expressing frustration with the way the league applies its rules.

“That’s the [expletive] dumbest goddamn thing I’ve ever seen. It’s [expletive] stupid,” declared the Philadelphia Eagles legend.

“Yeah, that sucks,” Travis Kelce agreed.

The discussion reflects a wider debate about how running backs are expected to protect themselves while also avoiding dangerous helmet contact. Skattebo is known for his physical approach, regularly using his strength to break tackles and drive through defenders.

Why Cam Skattebo's penalty has caused such a reaction

The call was particularly contentious because the contact occurred during a conventional running play, with Skattebo lowering his body as he prepared to meet Stewart.

Giants head coach John Harbaugh also questioned the decision immediately after it happened, arguing that the league needed to consider the physical demands placed on running backs.

Harbaugh subsequently explained that avoiding all head movement during contact is difficult for a player carrying the ball low to the ground. He wanted greater clarity from the NFL about how the rule should be interpreted in situations like this.

Skattebo himself was not prepared to change his playing style simply because of the penalty.

After the game, he expressed frustration with what he viewed as inconsistent treatment of his physical running, suggesting he would accept the consequences rather than stop playing aggressively.

The NFL's rules prohibit players from using the crown of their helmets to make forcible contact with an opponent. The intention is to reduce the risk of serious head and neck injuries, protecting both the player delivering the contact and the opponent.

However, the Skattebo incident has raised questions about how that rule should be applied when a running back is bracing for a tackle.

Despite the controversial moment, the Giants went on to secure an impressive 27-21 overtime victory in Houston. Skattebo finished with a career-best 124 rushing yards and a touchdown on 17 carries, while his 42-yard run in overtime helped put New York in position for the decisive score.

The penalty therefore did not prevent the Giants from leaving Houston with the win, but it has continued to attract attention in the days since the game.

The NFL could still review the play when considering potential disciplinary action. Skattebo has previously faced scrutiny over his use of the helmet, making the league's eventual decision particularly relevant to how he approaches future games.

Meanwhile, the Chiefs have their own priorities after suffering their first defeat of the season in Week 7, losing 20-3 to the defending champions, the Seattle Seahawks. Kansas City fell to 5-1 but remains in contention at the top of the AFC West.

Travis and his teammates will now look to respond against division rivals the Denver Broncos. Jason, meanwhile, has made his position on the Skattebo decision unmistakably clear: he believes the officials got it badly wrong.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes catches daughter Golden doing the trick she has mastered
articles.standfirst: Patrick Mahomes’ wife shared an adorable photo of her youngest daughter, who is beginning to master an art of her own.
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes’ wife shared an adorable photo of her youngest daughter, who is beginning to master an art of her own.
articles.body:
A little star in front of the camera! Brittany Mahomes shared a photo of her daughter Golden wearing a princess dress and flashing a smile that caught her attention . The picture came with a sweet caption revealing just how delighted she is to see her little girl getting better and better at posing for pictures.

“She’s getting the cheese down”, Patrick Mahomes’ wife wrote, also tagging him in the post.

The Mahomes family is already enjoying Halloween season

Golden’s photo came amid several fall-themed moments Brittany has shared with her followers. With Halloween just around the corner, the family has been making the most of the season with a few festive activities .

Earlier that same week, the businesswoman posted pictures from a visit to a pumpkin patch with Patrick and their three children: Sterling, five, Bronze, three, and Golden.

In one of the photos, the little ones posed on a haystack surrounded by pumpkins. They also enjoyed an animal-themed carousel, while Sterling posed next to bear figures beneath the decorative lights hanging from the trees.

Brittany also shows her support for Patrick Mahomes

The family posts have also offered glimpses of how Brittany and their children support Patrick throughout his season with the Kansas City Chiefs .

On October 21, she shared several photos of herself and the kids cheering on the quarterback during a game. “The best times”, she captioned the pictures .

As Patrick continues his NFL commitments, Brittany keeps sharing some of the special moments she enjoys with their little ones.

articles.title: Tyreek Hill raises further doubts among the Chiefs about his recovery after traveling to Germany to see a renowned doctor
articles.standfirst: Could Kansas City move on and sign another wide receiver in the 2026 NFL season?
articles.summary: Could Kansas City move on and sign another wide receiver in the 2026 NFL season?
articles.body:
T yreek Hill 's latest attempt to accelerate his recovery has taken him to Germany , where the former Kansas City Chiefs receiver is receiving treatment for his injured knee as doubts about his ability to take to the field in the 2026 NFL season continue to grow. The 32-year-old’s continued rehabilitation without a team is creating uncertainty to the extent of his ability to play football and the eight-time Pro Bowler shared footage from Munich on Snapchat , adding the location tag and the word, "Treatment."

Another video showed renowned physician Dr. Hans-Wilhelm Muller-Wohlfahrt working on Hill 's knee, although the visit does not establish whether he might be ready to play in the coming weeks despite the claims of his agent. Hill has been a free agent since Miami released him before the start of the offseason as he suffered a serious left knee injury against the New York whilst playing for the Dolphins , dislocating the joint and tearing multiple ligaments, including his ACL. Following two operations, he said he still needed to rebuild strength in his leg and Drew Rosenhaus has spoken with several teams about signing his client, but acknowledged there was "nothing immediate" available. Muller-Wohlfahrt is a familiar name in elite sport as he served as Bayern Munich 's team doctor for more than 40 years in soccer and worked with the German national team between 1995 and 2018.

Have the Chiefs moved on with their wide receiver search?

Hill 's previous production explains why teams might still consider taking a chance. He recorded more than 1000 receiving yards in six seasons with the Chiefs and Dolphins , won Super Bowl LIV . He has accumulated 11,363 receiving yards and 83 touchdowns. However, his recovery is not the only uncertainty surrounding his future. In October 2026, a civil jury found Hill liable for two counts of battery in a case brought by his estranged wife, Lakeeta Vaccaro , awarding her $500,000 in compensatory damages. Vaccaro accused him of physical and emotional abuse during their relationship and marriage. He disputed most allegations, and the jury rejected eight of her claims while finding him responsible for two incidents. He acknowledged pushing her against a wall during one confrontation and admitted making threatening remarks and the NFL confirmed it was monitoring developments after the verdict, opening the door to a potential suspension. Kansas City has other priorities as the November 10 trade deadline approaches and ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler said the Chiefs have "multiple lines in the water" as they explore ways to strengthen their receiving corps. Fowler mentioned Brian Thomas Jr. and Josh Downs as potential trade names, although he did not specifically connect either player to Kansas City whilst Rashod Bateman , Jerry Jeudy , Jauan Jennings and Chris Godwin are also options. Kansas City needs a receiver capable of stretching defenses vertically after Tyquan Thornton 's injury against the Las Vegas Raiders , sidelining the speedster until the NFL Playoffs at the earliest.

articles.title: The Chiefs are close to landing a new WR from the Colts, but the Steelers could put an end to the negotiations
articles.standfirst: Pittsburgh could hijack Kansas City's plans to land 25-year-old Colts receiver
articles.summary: Pittsburgh could hijack Kansas City's plans to land 25-year-old Colts receiver
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs appear to have identified a potential solution to their wide receiver problems, but the Pittsburgh Steelers could complicate their efforts to acquire Indianapolis Colts receiver Josh Downs.

With both AFC contenders reportedly submitting offers, the race for the 25-year-old playmaker is heating up ahead of the November 10 NFL trade deadline.

According to NFL insider Evan Sidery, Kansas City and Pittsburgh have each offered Day 3 draft compensation for Downs . Indianapolis initially sought a third-round selection but could settle for a fourth- or fifth-round pick.

A deal is expected to gain momentum after the weekend, although neither interested franchise has reached an agreement.

Downs ' potential departure follows a reported trade request on October 28. Although the receiver hasn't revealed the full reasons behind his decision, his recent comments suggest he's prepared to move on from Indianapolis.

"I'm open to whatever. Whatever comes my way, comes my way and we go from there," Downs said.

Selected in the third round of the 2023 NFL Draft, Downs has accumulated 2,447 receiving yards across 54 career appearances. His route-running ability and effectiveness from the slot could make him a valuable addition for either contender.

Why Pittsburgh could complicate Kansas City's plans

Kansas City arguably has the stronger immediate need for another receiver. Injuries have significantly disrupted its receiving corps, while Xavier Worthy has struggled to deliver consistent production.

Adding Downs would give Patrick Mahomes another dependable underneath target and potentially improve the offense's ability to sustain drives.

The Chiefs have already seen their pursuit of another major receiving target encounter difficulties. New York Jets receiver Garrett Wilson had emerged as a potential option, but ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Saturday that the franchise has no intention of trading him before the deadline.

Wilson's four-year, $130 million extension, which runs through 2030, makes a departure particularly difficult. His availability would've given Kansas City an opportunity to make a significant statement, but Downs could represent a more realistic alternative.

Pittsburgh, meanwhile, has its own reasons for entering the negotiations. The Steelers could use another weapon to support veteran quarterback Aaron Rodgers , particularly with D.K. Metcalf carrying much of the receiving responsibility.

Although Metcalf leads the team, production behind him has been less convincing. Downs could provide Rodgers with a reliable target over the middle, helping Pittsburgh improve its passing attack during the closing stages of the season.

However, there's also a potential downside. The Steelers already have younger receivers, including Roman Wilson , who could benefit from additional opportunities. Bringing in Downs might complicate their development plans.

Indianapolis' rebuilding direction could ultimately determine the receiver's destination. Following general manager Chris Ballard's dismissal, the Colts have already traded Quenton Nelson and DeForest Buckner , signaling their willingness to collect future draft capital.

Downs remains on Indianapolis' roster and is expected to feature in the Week 8 game plan. However, with the trade deadline approaching, Kansas City and Pittsburgh have limited time to complete a deal.

articles.title: Andy Reid can’t hide his joy when Travis Kelce surprises him with a cheeseburger in the Chiefs’ locker room
articles.standfirst: Travis Kelce’s sneaker-box surprise gives the Kansas City coach exactly what he wants
articles.summary: Travis Kelce’s sneaker-box surprise gives the Kansas City coach exactly what he wants
articles.body:
Andy Reid gets a surprise in a new video posted by the Chiefs: Travis Kelce walks into the locker room with a wrapped box that looks like it could hold sneakers. But when Reid opens it, there’s a cheeseburger inside. The players celebrate as the coach smiles at the reveal, turning his favorite food into the punchline of the scene.

Patrick Mahomes also appears in the playful montage , with the quarterback and Kelce joining their teammates in the joke. The video lands because Reid’s affection for cheeseburgers is already familiar to Chiefs fans.

After Kansas City won the AFC Championship, Reid summed up his celebration with a memorable line: “I had a cheeseburger and went to bed.”

The Chiefs look to bounce back against the Broncos

The lighthearted moment comes as Kansas City prepares for a tough divisional matchup . The Chiefs are 5-1 after losing 20-3 to Seattle on Oct. 25, their first defeat of the season. They visit the Denver Broncos on Sunday, Nov. 1, at 3:25 p.m. CT, with the game airing on CBS. NFL.com

Kenneth Walker III has given Reid’s offense a powerful running option since joining the Chiefs this season. He has rushed for 701 yards and six touchdowns on 120 carries through six games.

Seattle held him to 36 yards in his return to face his former team, but his strong start has helped give Kansas City another way to move the ball.

Mahomes and Kelce remain the familiar connection at the heart of the offense: the Chiefs credit them with 59 touchdown connections, the most by a quarterback and pass catcher in franchise history.

Kelce was limited in practice with an ankle issue earlier in the week, but he practiced fully Friday and was cleared from the injury report for Denver.

articles.standfirst: The Chiefs quarterback embraced this Saturday’s festivities by sharing a fun family tradition that has become a special annual occasion.
articles.summary: The Chiefs quarterback embraced this Saturday’s festivities by sharing a fun family tradition that has become a special annual occasion.
articles.body:
It’s Halloween, and while many families are getting their costumes ready to go trick-or-treating or celebrate the holiday, Patrick Mahomes has a special tradition of his own at home. The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback took a break from the demands of the NFL season to enjoy a family moment that quickly caught everyone's attention. This year, the inspiration came from a beloved movie that has captured the hearts of generations.

Patrick Mahomes and his family transform into Toy Story characters

Brittany Mahomes shared photos of the family's Halloween celebration on Saturday, October 31, showing everyone dressed up as characters from the Toy Story universe. Patrick stepped into the role of Buzz Lightyear, while Brittany transformed into Jessie, the spirited cowgirl from the movie .

The little ones also had their own parts to play in the adventure. Bronze Lavon Mahomes III dressed up as Woody, Golden wore a costume inspired by one of the little green aliens, and Sterling Skye Mahomes joined in as Barbie . Together, their coordinated costumes made the family look like they had stepped straight out of the beloved animated film.

This year's theme continues a tradition the family has shared with their followers on social media. In 2025, Patrick, Brittany, and their children went with the Spider-Man universe for Halloween . Patrick dressed as Miles Morales, Brittany took on the role of Aunt May, and the kids joined in with their own characters, including Spider-Gwen.

Patrick Mahomes returns to the NFL this Sunday to face the Broncos

After this fun and spooky Halloween break, Patrick Mahomes will turn his attention back to football. On Sunday, November 1, the Kansas City Chiefs will travel to Empower Field at Mile High to face the Denver Broncos in a Week 8 matchup with major implications for the AFC West standings.

The Chiefs enter the game with a 5-1 record, sitting atop the division despite coming off their first loss of the season . The Seattle Seahawks handed Kansas City a 20-3 defeat in their most recent outing. Meanwhile, Denver boasts a 5-2 record and is riding a three-game winning streak, putting the Broncos in a strong position to challenge their division rival for first place.

Sunday's matchup will also mark the second meeting between the two teams this season. Kansas City dominated their Week 1 encounter, securing a convincing 31-10 victory. However, the Broncos are in a very different position this time around and will look to take advantage of playing at home to turn the tables.

articles.title: Travis Kelce's neighbors are a major problem: The three points of contention regarding his $5.35 million Ohio mansion
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift and Kelce’s planned changes have run into firm resistance in near Cleveland Heights
articles.summary: Taylor Swift and Kelce’s planned changes have run into firm resistance in near Cleveland Heights
articles.body:
Travis Kelce 's $5.35 million Ohio home has become the focus of a dispute that reaches beyond the boundaries of his estate as neighbors have challenged proposed landscaping work, forcing the Kansas City Chiefs star's plans before the village's architectural review board. The objections concern three things: the removal and replacement of trees, the risk of disturbing a century-old shared sewer line, and whether the new planting would exceed local height restrictions at Bratenahl .

The board has postponed a decision whilst plans are revised and the disagreement is an unwelcome complication for the tight end, whose purchase brought him back close to Cleveland Heights , where he grew up as he prepares for life after retirement from the NFL . His attempt to settle near his hometown now faces a review process shaped partly by concerns from surrounding homeowners and one point of friction is the proposal to remove trees at the rear of the property as locals are concerned that work could affect their views towards Lake Erie . Making the landscaping plan a concern beyond Kelce 's own grounds, neighbors have also questioned what the work could mean for the shared sewer line as the concern is that construction or landscaping could damage the infrastructure, adding a practical issue to the debate. The final objection is the height of the replacement trees as local regulations set a maximum of 10 feet, and the original proposal did not meet that requirement whilst Kelce and Taylor Swift argue it is necessary to maintain their privacy and security from unwanted visitors. The board has requested an amended plan before considering approval and the project remains unresolved, with officials expected to revisit the application at their November 10 meeting. Kelce will have an opportunity to submit changes addressing the objections raised by nearby residents and bringing the plans into line with village regulations.

Kelce prepares for the Chiefs' matchup against Denver

Away from the property dispute, Kelce has been cleared to play against the Denver Broncos after participating fully in Friday's practice in a massive boost for the Chiefs at the Empower Field at Mile High in Colorado . The Kansas City catcher was not included on the injury report, easing concerns about his availability for the divisional matchup as the 5-1 Chiefs can essentially wrap up the division with a victory over the 5-2 Broncos , which could prove vital when it comes to resting for the NFL Playoffs . Kelce had sustained an ankle injury against the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 6 and was limited during Thursday's session after practicing fully on Wednesday but his return to unrestricted participation on Friday provided a positive update ahead of the game. Despite the defeat to the Seattle Seahawks , Kelce 's four receptions for 44 yards took his career receiving total, including playoff games, to 15,432 yards, the highest figure recorded by a tight end. His 1104 career receptions also place him fifth on the all-time list.

articles.title: Kansas City Chiefs vs Denver Broncos: Where to watch Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes today and what time the game is at Mile High
articles.standfirst: High-altitude showdown at Mile High: the Broncos host Chiefs looking to bounce back
articles.summary: High-altitude showdown at Mile High: the Broncos host Chiefs looking to bounce back
articles.body:
This Sunday, November 1, 2026, t he hottest rivalry in the AFC West heats up once again. In NFL Week 8 this season , the Denver Broncos host the Kansas City Chiefs at Empower Field at Mile High in Denver, which has a capacity of 76,125 fans.

Beyond the historical intrigue, something concrete is at stake: the lead in the AFC West . The Chiefs come in as the leaders of that group with a 5-1 record, while the Broncos are right behind them at 5-2.

A home win would tie things up at the top of the West; an away victory would leave Kansas City with a gap that would be hard to close. Rarely does a Week 8 game carry so much weight in the divisional race.

Where to watch today's Chiefs vs Broncos and what time does it start?

The opening whistle is scheduled for 4:25 p.m. Eastern Time (3:25 p.m. Central Time and 1:25 p.m. Pacific Time) this Sunday, November 1, 2026, at Empower Field at Mile High in Denver, home of the Broncos.

Regarding the broadcast in the United States, you will be able to watch the game through:

Streaming: Fubo, Paramount+, Hulu + Live TV, or YouTube TV

Kansas City Chiefs vs Denver Broncos: Match Overview

Denver arrives on a roll. After falling in the season opener, the home team has become a win-collecting machine : it is coming off a string of important victories, and in Week 7 it steamrolled the Arizona Cardinals 30-16 on the road.

Earlier, they had also won close contests against Seattle and the Chargers, in addition to a thrilling 30-26 victory over the Rams. Through seven games, they have scored 144 points and allowed 141: narrow margins that speak of a team that knows how to win one-possession games.

Kansas City, for its part, comes in with a thorn in its side. Its five-game winning streak was snapped in Week 7 , when it suffered a decisive 3-20 road loss to the Seattle Seahawks.

It was, by far, their worst offensive afternoon of the year: just 3 points for an offense accustomed to pulling out close games, like that 33-30 win over Indianapolis or the 30-27 victory in Las Vegas. The Chiefs' defense remains the team's best calling card: only 103 points allowed in six games, the lowest total in the entire AFC.

Chiefs vs Broncos under the microscope: recent history and key players

You don’t have to look far to gauge this rivalry: these same teams already faced off in Week 1 of this season, and the Chiefs won convincingly 31-10 at home.

That result set the tone for Kansas City's campaign and left Denver needing to reinvent itself. The Broncos did just that, and now they have the perfect opportunity to get revenge in front of their fans, in Denver's altitude, where visitors always struggle to breathe.

On the home side of the offense, the spotlight is on 26-year-old quarterback Bo Nix, tasked with leading an attack that has become reliable in pressure moments. He has plenty of weapons: veteran wide receiver Courtland Sutton, explosive Jaylen Waddle, and tight end Evan Engram give Nix targets for every area of the field. In the running game, J.K. Dobbins provides the balance that keeps any defense honest.

On the other side, the story has a first and last name: Patrick Mahomes, the architect of the Kansas City dynasty. Around him revolve the dangerous Rashee Rice, the pure speed of Xavier Worthy and, of course, the ageless tight end Travis Kelce, 37, who remains Mahomes' favorite safety valve on third down.

In the backfield, Kenneth Walker III gives the Chiefs a rushing engine that will look to neutralize the strong defense Denver has shown in recent weeks.

Implications in the race for the AFC West lead

The impact of this game goes beyond the AFC West. In the overall American Conference standings, Kansas City holds first place at 5-1, while Denver appears fifth at 5-2, right in the thick of the fight for postseason berths.

A Broncos victory would not only level the divisional race, but also catapult them into the conversation for a top spot in the AFC playoff seeding. For the Chiefs, winning would mean keeping control of their destiny and putting the Seattle stumble behind them before it turns into a bigger slump.

Chiefs vs Broncos Prediction: Who Is the Favorite in Week 8?

Kansas City has the best defense in the American Conference and the most influential player on the gridiron , but it comes in banged up and visits one of the toughest venues in the league. Denver, on the other hand, is going through its best stretch of the season and plays with the extra motivation of returning the blow from the 31-10 result in Week 1.

It looks set to be a close game, decided by one possession in the final minutes—exactly the kind of contest the Broncos have dominated in 2026. Prediction: Denver Broncos by a narrow margin, with the Chiefs fighting until their last breath at Mile High.

articles.title: Will Taylor Swift be at the Chiefs vs Broncos game? This is what we know about her possible attendance today
articles.standfirst: Swift attended the previous meeting at the Arrowhead Stadium in Week 1
articles.summary: Swift attended the previous meeting at the Arrowhead Stadium in Week 1
articles.body:
Taylor Swift 's presence at Kansas City Chiefs games has become one of the NFL 's most recognizable celebrity storylines since her relationship with Travis Kelce became public and attention now turns to whether she will travel to Denver for Sunday's meeting with the Broncos on November 1. Swift has attended several important moments in Kelce 's Chiefs career, including Super Bowl appearances and regular-season fixtures as her appearances have also brought an entertainment audience to the NFL , with television cameras frequently showing her reactions from the stands.

The connection began when Kelce attended Swift 's Eras Tour concert at Arrowhead Stadium as he later explained that he had hoped to give the singer a friendship bracelet with his phone number. However, did not get the opportunity before he subsequently invited her to a Chiefs game in a bid to secure a second chance at linking up with the 37-year-old billionaire. Swift accepted and her first appearance came in September 2023, when Kansas City faced the Chicago Bears and she soon became a familiar figure at Arrowhead . Often watching alongside friends and family, as her relationship with the tight end blossomed, Swift is typically spotted in the VIP suites on gameday having become a football fanatic.

Will Taylor Swift attend Chiefs vs Broncos on November 1?

Swift attended the Chiefs ' September 14 season opener against the Broncos in Kansas City as she watched alongside Tom Cruise , marking her first time seeing Kelce play since their wedding earlier in the year and she also appeared at the clash with the Indianapolis Colts in Week 2. That appearance followed a significant personal milestone as Swift and Kelce married on July 3 in New York City , with Adam Sandler officiating with Taylor ’s brother, Austin , serving as her Man of Honor, while Travis ’ brother Jason served as Best Man. Swift has continued to support Kelce since the wedding as she was also at Arrowhead for Kansas City 's October 18 game against the Chargers , sitting Caitlin Clark as the Chiefs recorded a 22-6 victory. But her attendance at the November 1 game remains unconfirmed at Empower Field at Mile High , with the clash being a road fixture rather than one of the home appearances that have featured prominently in her recent schedule in Missouri . Her recent travel record offers less encouragement for those expecting to see her in Denver, as the singer was absent from Kansas City 's October 4 road game against the Las Vegas Raiders in Nevada and its October 25 trip to face the Seattle Seahawks in Washington . Those absences have strengthened the impression that Arrowhead is her preferred setting for watching Kelce as security considerations have previously been cited as a possible reason for favoring a familiar stadium where arrangements can be assessed and managed. Although attending in Denver cannot be ruled out, there is currently no reliable confirmation that she will make the trip. Swift was present when the Chiefs welcomed the Broncos , but this time she may remain at home watching her husband from the comfort of her living room.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes sends warning to Chiefs fans: Why Kansas City may never win another Super Bowl
articles.standfirst: The quarterback addressed the painful defeat and revealed what could keep them from winning against top-tier teams.
articles.summary: The quarterback addressed the painful defeat and revealed what could keep them from winning against top-tier teams.
articles.body:
After an impressive 5-0 start to the season, Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs are going through their first rough patch of the year after suffering two consecutive losses.

The first defeat came in Week 7 , when the Chiefs were stunned by the defending champions, the Seattle Seahawks , who secured a 20-3 victory . This Sunday, Kansas City stumbled again and fell to a 5-2 record after losing to the Denver Broncos 28-24 .

The Chiefs held an 11-point lead in the fourth quarter but were unable to protect it. Denver completed a spectacular comeback by outscoring Kansas City 1 5-0 in the final period , earning its fourth consecutive win of the season.

Mahomes completed 30 of 41 passes for 321 yards, three touchdowns and no interceptions. However, the two-time NFL MVP’s outstanding performance was not enough to prevent the Chiefs from suffering another defeat.

Patrick Mahomes spoke after falling on the road in Denver

The Chiefs quarterback revealed the real reason why they were unable to hold on for the victory during their visit to Denver.

“We just made too many mistakes—when you make mistakes you’re going to lose against good football teams,” said Kansas City’s star quarterback after the loss.

With five receptions and 128 yards, Emmett Johnson was by far the best offensive player supporting Patrick Mahomes. The quarterback had nothing but praise for the rookie, who stepped up despite the defeat:

“I thought he did a great job today, he’s done great the entire time he’s been here and as the season goes on we’ll continue to utilize him more.”

Despite the setback, the quarterback made history once again. Mahomes recorded his 49th regular-season game with at least three touchdown passes, surpassing Peyton Manning and Dan Marino for the most such games by a player in his first 10 NFL seasons.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes' furious post after Chiefs' game-ending call vs Broncos
articles.standfirst: Brittany Mahomes questioned the officials after a disputed penalty changed the outcome of Kansas City’s loss.
articles.summary: Brittany Mahomes questioned the officials after a disputed penalty changed the outcome of Kansas City’s loss.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs suffered their second consecutive road loss on Sunday, falling 28-24 to their divisional rivals, the Denver Broncos . However, the game was surrounded by controversy in the final moments.

Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs let an 11-point lead slip away in the fourth quarter. Kansas City entered the final period with a 24-13 advantage, but the Broncos responded with 15 points in the closing minutes to complete a spectacular comeback and secure the victory.

The Chiefs still had one final opportunity to turn the game around. Facing fourth-and-goal from Denver’s 1-yard line, Mahomes connected with Rashee Rice on a play that appeared to become the game-winning touchdown. However, the score was overturned after officials called a false start on right tackle Jaylon Moore .

The penalty moved Kansas City back to Denver’s 6-yard line , and on the following play, Mahomes was sacked, ending the Chiefs’ comeback attempt.

The controversial decision sparked a furious reaction from Brittany Mahomes , who did not hesitate to express her frustration on social media.

“You can’t tell me you call that on a game winning TD, oh wait yeah I can cause it’s us. That was the weakest call I have ever seen, you can’t tell me otherwise,” she wrote in an Instagram story.

Brittany Mahomes, who has attended several Chiefs games at Arrowhead Stadium this season, made her frustration with the officiating clear and questioned the officials’ decision, believing the penalty hurt Kansas City at a crucial moment.

Following the loss, Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs fell to a 5-2 record after dropping two straight games. Kansas City slipped to second place in the AFC West , while the Broncos, now 6-2, took over the division lead thanks to four consecutive victories.

The Chiefs will have a chance to get back in the win column on November 8 , when they return home to host the New York Jets at Arrowhead Stadium , looking to avoid a third straight defeat.

articles.title: Harrison Butker's contract with the Chiefs has saved him from being cut for now, but his future is starting to look bleak
articles.standfirst: Butker missed another vital field goal in the Week 8 loss to the Denver Broncos
articles.summary: Butker missed another vital field goal in the Week 8 loss to the Denver Broncos
articles.body:
Harrison Butker 's position with the Kansas City Chiefs is becoming increasingly uncertain after another costly miss exposed his declining reliability as whilst his fully guaranteed contract protects his immediate future, the team's recent move to bring in Justin Tucker raises questions. The latest setback came against the Denver Broncos in Week 8, when Butker failed to convert a 54-yard field goal late in the fourth quarter. Kansas City had been leading by three points.

​But the miss gave Denver an opportunity to take control as Patrick Mahomes had been sacked for a six-yard loss on third down, turning what would have been a 48-yard attempt into a much longer kick. However, Butker sent his effort wide right, and Denver subsequently drove downfield to score the decisive touchdown. Andy Reid defended the decision to attempt the kick, arguing that the distance remained achievable for his veteran specialist. "Those are hindsight. It ended up being what it was," Reid said, via FOX 4 Kansas City. "But it's within Harrison's range." Yet Butker 's recent performances make that assessment harder to defend statistically. He has struggled from longer distances, missing three significant attempts across the Chiefs ' recent defeats, including two against the Seattle Seahawks the previous week. Through 2023, Butker converted 89.1 percent of his field goals and made 28 of 40 attempts from beyond 50 yards. Since then, his overall success rate has fallen to 82.2 percent, while his conversion rate from that distance has dropped to 44.4 percent.

Why Harrison Butker's contract complicates the Chiefs' decision

But it is his 2026 numbers are particularly concerning as Butker has converted only one of five attempts from beyond 50 yards, including the miss against Denver , while another attempt from 45 yards against the Broncos also went wide right. Kansas City has already taken steps to explore alternatives, signing former Baltimore Ravens kicker Tucker to its practice squad earlier in the week despite him not playing in the NFL since 2024 after multiple women accused him of sexual misconduct. He denies the claims. Despite the competition, Butker 's contract makes an immediate release financially difficult as his four-year, $25 million agreement is fully guaranteed for the current season, meaning cutting him now would offer the Chiefs little financial relief. Spotrac reported that Butker is receiving a guaranteed $5.8 million salary this season, but the remaining two years and $11.7 million on his deal are not protected. His contract runs through 2028, leaving Kansas City a potential opportunity to move on after the current campaign. Butker has earned more than $36 million during his NFL career and previously established himself among the league's leading kickers though his recent decline has changed the discussion around his place in Kansas City . The Chiefs could still retain him for the remainder of the season because of his contract, but the arrival of Tucker creates genuine competition and unless Butker improves in the coming weeks, his long-term future with the franchise will remain under serious scrutiny.

articles.title: The controversial referee's call against the Chiefs has Andy Reid rightfully complaining: “I didn't see it”
articles.standfirst: Jaylon Moore was penalized for a false start as Rashee Rice caught what he thought was the game-ending touchdown
articles.summary: Jaylon Moore was penalized for a false start as Rashee Rice caught what he thought was the game-ending touchdown
articles.body:
A ndy Reid was left questioning a decisive officiating call after the Kansas City Chiefs suffered a 28-24 defeat to the Denver Broncos , with a late false-start penalty wiping out a potential game-winning touchdown and leaving the coach frustrated. The Chiefs appeared to have found a way through Denver 's defense with four seconds remaining, but a flag against right tackle Jaylon Moore erased Patrick Mahomes ' pass to Rashee Rice in the end zone.

The penalty moved Kansas City back five yards and gave the advantage to the Broncos and Reid admitted he had not witnessed the alleged infraction, although he had noticed movement from Moore . “I didn't see it. I saw him move his head, but I didn't see [a false start],” Reid said, according to ESPN's Nate Taylor as the coach also acknowledged the wider discipline problem that had affected his team throughout the afternoon. “I thought the guys battled like crazy,” Reid added at the Empower Field at Mile High in Colorado . “We had over 100 yards in penalties. We've got to take care of that.” The penalty controversy came amid a difficult afternoon for Kansas City 's discipline as the Chiefs committed 11 penalties for 105 yards, while eight first-half flags accounted for 75 yards. Four penalties also gave Denver fresh sets of downs. According to Associated Press reporter Josh Dubow , it was only the fourth time under Reid that Kansas City had committed at least eight penalties for 75 or more yards in the first half.

Chiefs slump to loss at Mile High

Kansas City had entered the fourth quarter with a 24-13 advantage, but failed to add to its score as Denver mounted a comeback as Bo Nix connected with Nate Adkins for a two-yard touchdown before finding Jaylen Waddle for the two-point conversion. Harrison Butker subsequently missed a 54-yard field goal with around two and a half minutes remaining, giving Denver the opportunity to take control as Nix needed only two plays to put the Broncos ahead. Finding rookie Jonah Coleman for a 51-yard gain before the running back scored from five yards out before Mahomes then led the Chiefs back downfield, helped by Emmett Johnson 's 44-yard kickoff return and a 32-yard reception from Travis Kelce . Kansas City reached the Denver 1-yard line with 35 seconds remaining, setting up the sequence that ended its comeback attempt but after Moore 's penalty moved the ball back, Mahomes was unable to complete the next play. But Malcolm Roach managed to get pressure on the quarterback, recording the sack for a six-yard loss as Denver secured the victory, extending their winning streak in one-score games to 15 across the last two seasons. The Broncos improved to 6-2 and moved into first place in the AFC West , half a game ahead of the 5-2 Chiefs , who have now lost twice in succession.

articles.title: Harrison Butker takes responsibility and blames himself for the Chiefs' loss: “I just completely missed the ball”
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City Chiefs have now lost control of the AFC West and Butker played a big part in the defeat
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs have now lost control of the AFC West and Butker played a big part in the defeat
articles.body:
H arrison Butker offered no excuses after his missed kick became a turning point in a defeat to the Denver Broncos , making clear that the responsibility rested with him as the Kansas City Chiefs kicker said the attempt was simply a poor piece of execution.

With Kansas City leading late in the fourth quarter, Butker pushed a 54-yard field goal wide right, and Denver capitalized almost immediately by scoring the touchdown that put the Broncos ahead 28-24 and left the Chiefs chasing the game.

Rain had begun falling by the time Butker lined up from a relatively far distance, but he rejected the suggestion that the weather explained what happened as he shook his head and described how he messed the moment up at the Empower Field at Mile High .

“Might have been one of my best weeks of practice. Justin's been great,” Butker said, referring to Justin Tucker , who had joined Kansas City 's practice squad. “But it doesn't matter. When I say bad miss, I just completely missed the ball.

“Didn't even give it a chance, so that one just felt really bad and not good enough, obviously."

Chiefs turn to Justin Tucker as Butker’s struggles continue

The admission comes amid a season in which Butker has missed six field goals in seven games as his latest failure followed two missed attempts against the Seattle Seahawks , prompting the Chiefs to bring in Tucker after previously sticking with their established kicker.

And Andy Reid explained that Kansas City had assessed three candidates before choosing Tucker but the coach declined to detail the club's investigation into the allegations that led to his suspension.

Instead said the organization had spoken to multiple people before making its decision to bring the former Baltimore Raven onboard after he served a 10-game suspension after sexual misconduct allegations were made by 16 massage therapists.

“So he's done his suspension, you know, and take care of that business there. I'll leave it at that for ya,” Reid said when questioned about the signing whilst he added that the Chiefs had considered what had happened since the allegations emerged.

Reid also made clear that the decision was not intended to signal a personal falling-out with Butker as the coach said the player understood the business decision and acknowledged that the kicker had to respond on the field.

“He understands the business and how it works and we had a practice squad position open,” Reid said. “And so for security, we brought [Tucker] in and put him in that spot we had open.

"Butker gets it. He knows that's part of this business. He's struggled a little bit and he gets it. He needs to pick it up here a little bit."

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes' complaint against the referees sparks a new controversy: “The referees handed her husband a Super Bowl in the 2022-23 season”
articles.standfirst: Brittany was left unimpressed with a false start penalty called against the Kansas City Chiefs
articles.summary: Brittany was left unimpressed with a false start penalty called against the Kansas City Chiefs
articles.body:
B rittany Mahomes did not hold back after a late penalty erased a potential Kansas City Chiefs touchdown against the Denver Broncos , but her criticism quickly attracted a wave of backlash from fans who pointed to controversial calls that have previously benefited Patrick Mahomes . With four seconds remaining and Kansas City trailing 28-24, Mahomes appeared to have delivered a dramatic winner by finding Rashee Rice in the end zone but officials instead penalized right tackle Jaylon Moore for a false start, cancelling the score and pushing the Chiefs five yards further from the goal line.

The Chiefs could not get the job done as the Broncos defense pulled through to secure the win by sacking the quarterback, and Brittany then took her frustration to social media, questioning why such a call would be made at such a decisive moment. However, her reaction divided supporters, with some sharing her disbelief while others reminded her that Kansas City has also benefited from contentious officiating decisions – including in Super Bowls . “You can't tell me you call that on a game-winning TD,” Brittany wrote via Instagram Stories. “Oh wait yeah I can 'cause it's us. The weakest call I have ever seen. You can't tell me otherwise.” And unsurprisingly, the response was swift as fans mocked the Chiefs ' complaints about referees. One fan wrote via X.com, formerly known as Twitter, “Chiefs fans complaining about refs LMAOOOOOOOOOO.” A second said, “The Chiefs literally won a Super Bowl because of a comically weak defensive holding call against the Eagles. Spare me.” And a third simply commented, “Sure Brittany.”

Have the Chiefs had bad luck with the referees in the 2026 NFL season?

Andy Reid also questioned the late flag in Denver , as the argument surrounding Sunday's defeat has reopened a wider discussion about Kansas City 's experiences with officials this season, but the record is not entirely one-sided. With disputed decisions in earlier games against the Indianapolis Colts and the Las Vegas Raiders also drawing attention, even CBS analyst J.J. Watt had also highlighted other decisions during the contest against the Broncos , including a holding penalty against Trey Smith and a facemask call against Drue Tranquill . Kansas City 's September 20 meeting with the Colts provided a different kind of controversy as Indianapolis won a disputed first-down spot involving Keenan Allen , while an overtime review overturned a fumble ruling against Laquon Treadwell . Ruling the player down by contact, the Colts retained possession and had a chance to win the game instead of a contest-ending recovery for the Chiefs , as Mahomes eventually guided Kansas City to a 33-30 victory in overtime. The incident therefore offered little support for the argument that officiating decisions had consistently worked against Kansas City whilst the October 4 game against Las Vegas brought another disputed moment. A late reception by Tre Tucker was allowed to stand despite television footage appearing to show the ball touching the ground and former NFL Vice President of Officiating, Dean Blandino , argued that officials should have intervened inside the final two minutes – although the Chiefs pulled through. Additional questions of hip drop tackles injuring Tyquan Thorton and Travis Kelce in recent weeks whilst also going unchecked have only added to the build-up to Brittany ’s controversial post as those incidents complicate the suggestion that Kansas City has been repeatedly disadvantaged. However, there was more to the Broncos defeat than referees as Kansas City surrendered a 24-13 advantage in the fourth quarter, while Harrison Butker missed a 54-yard field goal before Denver scored the decisive touchdown as Mahomes finished with 321 passing yards and three touchdowns.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes receives a suspicious $1.9 million "gift" from the Chiefs, possibly related to Tyreek Hill
articles.standfirst: Kansas City restructured its quarterback's contract to drastically reduce his impact on the 2026 salary cap. The space created is not money Mahomes will receive, but it does give the franchise room to strengthen the offense, with Hill among the names linked to the team.
articles.summary: Kansas City restructured its quarterback's contract to drastically reduce his impact on the 2026 salary cap. The space created is not money Mahomes will receive, but it does give the franchise room to strengthen the offense, with Hill among the names linked to the team.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs found a way to gain room under the salary cap through Patrick Mahomes' contract. The franchise converted $54.45 million of his 2026 salary into a bonus, a move that reduced his hit against the salary cap from $78.2 million to $34.65 million and generated approximately $43.56 million in space for the team.

That move is what lies behind the idea of the supposed “gift” for Mahomes: the quarterback does not receive an additional 1.9 million, nor is money handed directly to him. What Kansas City gains is room to bring in players around its main star. In other words, the benefit for Mahomes is on the field : the Chiefs have more flexibility to strengthen an offense that needs new pieces, and one of the possibilities that has emerged is the return of Tyreek Hill.

More room to build around Mahomes

The restructuring was necessary because Kansas City was facing a complicated salary cap situation. Mahomes was scheduled to represent a $78.214 million cap hit in 2026, a figure the franchise managed to reduce by converting part of his salary into a bonus spread over several years of the contract. NFL

The move, however, does not make that money disappear. Part of the burden simply shifts to the following seasons . Mahomes' cap hit in 2027, for example, increases to about $85.25 million under the current structure.

It is the price Kansas City accepts paying in order to have greater immediate flexibility.

That’s where Tyreek Hill comes in. The wide receiver was one of Mahomes’ main weapons during his first years in the NFL and, together with the quarterback, formed one of Kansas City’s most productive offensive duos. His possible return has been linked to the Chiefs’ need to add talent to the receiving corps.

The interest, however, does not mean that Hill is going to return to Kansas City. The possibility of a reunion has been reported, but any move would depend on the financial terms and the player's contract situation. The salary cap space allows for flexibility, but it is not the same as a finalized deal.

The price of freeing up space

The decision also shows how salary cap management works in the NFL. By converting part of Mahomes' salary into a bonus, the Chiefs can spread that amount out for accounting purposes over the remaining years of the contract. In this way, they reduce the quarterback's immediate impact and free up money for other moves .

Mahomes, therefore, has not accepted a pay cut. The move changes when and how Kansas City accounts for that money against the salary cap, but maintains the financial obligations of the contract. The quarterback remains tied to a deal that was originally signed for 10 years and $450 million in 2020.

For the Chiefs, the goal is to use that flexibility to build a competitive roster around Mahomes. The current cap space is no longer the same as the one created by that initial restructuring and, according to Over The Cap, Kansas City currently has around $1.3 million in room, a figure that could change with further roster moves.

That’s why, if Tyreek Hill ends up returning to Kansas City, the connection to Mahomes’ contract will be indirect but important: the quarterback’s restructuring made it possible to create the space the franchise needed to make moves in the market. The “gift” was not for Mahomes in the form of money, but rather an opportunity for the Chiefs to once again surround him with offensive weapons.
paragraphs: The Kansas City Chiefs found a way to gain room under the salary cap through Patrick Mahomes' contract. The franchise converted $54.45 million of his 2026 salary into a bonus, a move that reduced his hit against the salary cap from $78.2 million to $34.65 million and generated approximately $43.56 million in space for the team.

That move is what lies behind the idea of the supposed “gift” for Mahomes: the quarterback does not receive an additional 1.9 million, nor is money handed directly to him. What Kansas City gains is room to bring in players around its main star. In other words, the benefit for Mahomes is on the field : the Chiefs have more flexibility to strengthen an offense that needs new pieces, and one of the possibilities that has emerged is the return of Tyreek Hill.
More room to build around Mahomes

The restructuring was necessary because Kansas City was facing a complicated salary cap situation. Mahomes was scheduled to represent a $78.214 million cap hit in 2026, a figure the franchise managed to reduce by converting part of his salary into a bonus spread over several years of the contract. NFL

The move, however, does not make that money disappear. Part of the burden simply shifts to the following seasons . Mahomes' cap hit in 2027, for example, increases to about $85.25 million under the current structure.
It is the price Kansas City accepts paying in order to have greater immediate flexibility.

That’s where Tyreek Hill comes in. The wide receiver was one of Mahomes’ main weapons during his first years in the NFL and, together with the quarterback, formed one of Kansas City’s most productive offensive duos. His possible return has been linked to the Chiefs’ need to add talent to the receiving corps.

The interest, however, does not mean that Hill is going to return to Kansas City. The possibility of a reunion has been reported, but any move would depend on the financial terms and the player's contract situation. The salary cap space allows for flexibility, but it is not the same as a finalized deal.
The price of freeing up space

The decision also shows how salary cap management works in the NFL. By converting part of Mahomes' salary into a bonus, the Chiefs can spread that amount out for accounting purposes over the remaining years of the contract. In this way, they reduce the quarterback's immediate impact and free up money for other moves .

Mahomes, therefore, has not accepted a pay cut. The move changes when and how Kansas City accounts for that money against the salary cap, but maintains the financial obligations of the contract. The quarterback remains tied to a deal that was originally signed for 10 years and $450 million in 2020.

For the Chiefs, the goal is to use that flexibility to build a competitive roster around Mahomes. The current cap space is no longer the same as the one created by that initial restructuring and, according to Over The Cap, Kansas City currently has around $1.3 million in room, a figure that could change with further roster moves.

That’s why, if Tyreek Hill ends up returning to Kansas City, the connection to Mahomes’ contract will be indirect but important: the quarterback’s restructuring made it possible to create the space the franchise needed to make moves in the market. The “gift” was not for Mahomes in the form of money, but rather an opportunity for the Chiefs to once again surround him with offensive weapons.

articles.title: Travis Kelce fights back tears as Chiefs star delivers emotional admission after Broncos loss
articles.standfirst: The tight end is putting the responsibility on his own shoulders as Kansas City struggles to find answers
articles.summary: The tight end is putting the responsibility on his own shoulders as Kansas City struggles to find answers
articles.body:
T ravis Kelce has no problem showing how much football affects him emotionally. Following the Kansas City Chiefs' loss to the Denver Broncos, Kelce not only looked visibly frustrated with the result but also came close to tears during his postgame interview.

The tight end made it clear that he needs to be much better for his team. He appears to have identified the areas where he needs to improve, but his reaction also showed how much responsibility he feels as one of the team's leaders. With his voice cracking and long sighs interrupting his thoughts, Kelce gave the impression that he is carrying the weight of the team on his shoulders and knows there is very little room for mistakes.

Kelce turns the criticism toward himself

His words were harsh, particularly when it came to evaluating his own performance. His expression left little doubt about how disappointed he was, as h e recognized that things need to change and that improving is no longer optional.

Kelce also took responsibility for his contribution to the team's struggles, admitting that his level of play has to improve moving forward. He briefly apologized for his language as he expressed his frustration, making it clear that he cannot afford to keep making the same mistakes . He also acknowledged that his performance sets the tone for many of his teammates in the locker room.

Chiefs face growing pressure after another defeat

The Kansas City Chiefs are now searching for answers after suffering their second consecutive loss, and Kelce needs to find those answers sooner rather than later . The mood around the team is clearly low following a controversial and difficult game to accept, leaving the tight end particularly frustrated with where things stand.

articles.standfirst: Denver stopped Patrick Mahomes at the 1-yard line with four seconds left on the clock and won 28-24. While the actress jumped for joy at home, Brittany Mahomes looked dejected at the stadium.
articles.summary: Denver stopped Patrick Mahomes at the 1-yard line with four seconds left on the clock and won 28-24. While the actress jumped for joy at home, Brittany Mahomes looked dejected at the stadium.
articles.body:
The Denver Broncos came from behind to defeat the Kansas City Chiefs 28-24 on Sunday, November 1. The game was decided on the final play: Denver’s defense stopped Patrick Mahomes at the 1-yard line with four seconds remaining.

One of the most talked-about reactions came from Kate Hudson, who watched the game at home with her family. The Broncos themselves posted a video on social media of the actress celebrating the final stop, and the clip has gone viral.

The stop at the one-yard line and the reactions

Footage of the game’s closing moments shows defensive player Malcolm Roach sacking Mahomes. The team, led by Sean Payton, thus sealed the comeback against one of the league’s toughest opponents.

In the video,and shouting as she watches the game in her home theater. Actor Kurt Russell can be seen in the background, also watching the screen. The Broncos’ account accompanied the clip with a message: “Kate Hudson was all of Broncos Country watching that game.”

On the other hand, Brittany Mahomes, wife of the Chiefs’ quarterback, was seen visibly upset after the loss, according to ClutchPoints. Mahomes’ wife has not commented on the game.

Hudson is no newcomer to the fan base . She grew up in Colorado during the John Elway era in the 1980s and has frequently shown her support for the team for years. Nearly a decade ago, for example, she got a temporary tattoo in the Broncos’ colors.

Other figures in the entertainment industry also followed the outcome. Ben Stiller reacted with surprise to the stop at the goal line, according to the headline of another article published by ClutchPoints.

Kansas City went into halftime leading 17-13 and extended its lead to 24-13 in the third quarter with a four-yard pass from Mahomes to N. Gray. Earlier, he had connected with R. Rice (11 yards) and E. Johnson (73). The Chiefs racked up 321 passing yards and three touchdown passes, but were penalized 11 times for 105 yards.

Denver responded with 15 straight points in the fourth quarter. Bo Nix threw a two-yard pass to N. Adkins with nine minutes remaining and, on the two-point conversion, found J. articles.title: Patrick Mahomes and Harrison Butker ruin Chiefs heiress Gracie Hunt's victory pose
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs heiress dazzles fans with her latest game-day look, but Kansas City's late collapse against Denver leaves supporters disappointed
articles.summary: The Chiefs heiress dazzles fans with her latest game-day look, but Kansas City's late collapse against Denver leaves supporters disappointed
articles.body:
Gracie Hunt turned heads at Empower Field at Mile High as she arrived to support the Kansas City Chiefs , but her stylish appearance wasn't enough to inspire a victory against the Denver Broncos .

The 27-year-old daughter of Chiefs billionaire owner Clark Hunt shared several photographs from the sidelines, showing off a striking red jumpsuit. She completed the look with a confident pose and a caption that read: “A little altitude, a lot of attitude.”

Her outfit quickly caught the attention of her Instagram followers, with many praising her appearance. Several fans described her as beautiful and stunning, while others embraced the nickname “lady in red”.

Hunt regularly attracts attention through her fashion choices and social media posts, and her latest appearance proved why.

However, the Chiefs couldn't deliver the result she would've wanted. Kansas City suffered a painful 28-24 defeat after surrendering a huge lead in the closing stages. Denver produced a remarkable fourth-quarter comeback, scoring 15 unanswered points to secure an important divisional victory.

The result left Kansas City with a 5-2 record, while the Broncos improved to 6-2, adding further pressure on the Chiefs as they look to regain their early-season momentum.

Patrick Mahomes and Harrison Butker contribute to Chiefs' costly mistakes

Patrick Mahomes didn't hide his frustration after the defeat, pointing towards poor execution, unnecessary penalties and communication problems as major reasons behind the disappointing result.

The quarterback finished with 321 passing yards and three touchdown passes, but admitted that his team hadn't maintained the required standard throughout the contest.

"Yeah, obviously penalties, some miscommunications between me and the receivers and running backs and stuff like that," Mahomes said. "Just in general, the execution wasn't at a high enough level.

"We made big plays and we made plays happen against a really good defense. But whenever you're playing a team like that in the division you've got to execute for the full 60 minutes, and we weren't able to do that."

One particularly frustrating moment came late in the game when a false-start penalty wiped out what appeared to be a go-ahead touchdown involving Rashee Rice . The costly decision pushed Kansas City backwards, and Mahomes was subsequently sacked on fourth down, ending the Chiefs' hopes of reclaiming the lead.

Harrison Butker also endured a difficult moment after missing a 54-yard field-goal attempt in the fourth quarter. The missed kick added to Kansas City's problems, although he'd previously converted a 45-yard attempt and several extra points.

Travis Kelce shared Mahomes ' disappointment, criticizing the team's lack of discipline while accepting responsibility for his own performance. Head coach Andy Reid also admitted he hadn't clearly seen the movement that resulted in the late false-start call.

The Chiefs must now quickly turn their attention towards Week 9, when they'll face the New York Jets. Kansas City will be eager to rediscover its winning form and avoid allowing consecutive defeats to derail its campaign.

While Hunt's red outfit earned plenty of admiration online, Mahomes, Butker and the rest of the Chiefs had considerably less to celebrate after their Denver disappointment.

articles.title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's married life comes with one huge, unexpected catch
articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift changed her routine for Travis Kelce, but her ambitions remain stronger than ever. The pop superstar is balancing married life with new music and Hollywood projects.
articles.summary: Taylor Swift changed her routine for Travis Kelce, but her ambitions remain stronger than ever. The pop superstar is balancing married life with new music and Hollywood projects.
articles.body:
Marriage has led Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce to build a new relationship dynamic, based on shared routines, family moments and constant support for each other's demanding careers.

However, adapting to this new chapter has also required changes, especially as Kelce faces another demanding NFL season. Although Swift appears to be fully enjoying her life as a wife, the pop superstar has reportedly adjusted some aspects of her daily routine while quietly preparing for her next major professional projects.

Taylor Swift adjusts her routine to support Travis Kelce

For years, Taylor Swift's career shaped much of the couple's schedule. Now, the singer has also found a way to make room for Travis Kelce's commitments with the Kansas City Chiefs .

With many believing the tight end could be entering the final stage of his NFL career , Swift has made it a priority to support and stand by him throughout the season.

"She accepts that Travis has to commit so much time to the Chiefs," an insider told the Daily Mail . "She never complains because football is his passion. He has been in practice since August, so he has been hyper-focused for a long time."

That commitment is also reflected in their lifestyle. The couple frequently works out together, especially with weight-training routines, while their diet has become more focused on nutrition and protein intake to meet Kelce's physical demands.

"They work out a ton together," the source said, adding, "They love to lift weights and stay strong, and they stick to a lean diet. There is a lot of protein in their meals."

Taylor Swift's new family life with Travis Kelce

The couple's life together has also taken on a more family-oriented direction. According to reports, Swift is spending more time with Kelce's loved ones, especially his mother, Donna Kelce, with whom she has developed a close relationship.

Recently, the two women were seen hugging inside a private suite at Arrowhead Stadium during the Chiefs' victory over the Los Angeles Chargers .

The source said Swift genuinely enjoys spending time with her husband's family. "They see a ton of Travis' family and she loves his mom."

In addition to strengthening their family bonds, the couple has also expanded their household with the arrival of a new pet. According to the report, Swift and Kelce welcomed a white Samoyed named Wendy , a special addition considering the singer's well-known love for her three cats: Meredith Grey, Olivia Benson and Benjamin Button .

According to the source, the animals have adjusted easily to living together and now "spend a lot of time" sharing the same space.

Taylor Swift keeps her Hollywood ambitions alive

Despite enjoying this new personal chapter, Taylor Swift has not put aside her professional goals. Her happiness in marriage has not slowed down her creative plans or ambitions beyond music.

The singer continues working on new material and, according to a source close to her, she already has enough songs to potentially complete two albums.

"Taylor takes notes, hums new melodies and reads a lot of books for inspiration," the source revealed.

Swift also remains in contact with influential figures in the industry, including Este Haim and Selena Gomez , while continuing to draw inspiration from icons such as Carly Simon and Stevie Nicks .

Her goals may even extend beyond music. According to reports, the artist is preparing a potential Academy Awards campaign connected to "I Knew It, I Knew You," the song she contributed to "Toy Story 5."

Balancing these projects with Travis Kelce's NFL schedule has meant a demanding travel routine. The "Cruel Summer" singer frequently moves between the couple's different residences to fulfill her professional commitments and support her husband, although she apparently does not view it as a sacrifice.

"Taylor doesn't mind all the traveling she does for her career and for Travis' career," the source said, adding, "She hops between their homes and has a great team around her."

articles.title: No Regrets: Andy Reid refuses to use Harrison Butker as a scapegoat for the 54-yard disaster
articles.standfirst: Butker missed another vital kick as the Kansas City Chiefs lost to the Denver Broncos
articles.summary: Butker missed another vital kick as the Kansas City Chiefs lost to the Denver Broncos
articles.body:
Andy Reid has refused to make Harrison Butker the scapegoat for the Kansas City Chiefs ’ 28-24 defeat to Denver Broncos , defending his kicker after a missed 54-yard field goal helped swing the game as the head coach instead pointed to the protection breakdown. The Chiefs led by 11 points entering the fourth quarter, but surrendered their advantage as Bo Nix inspired Denver ’s comeback and Butker ’s late miss gave the Broncos an opening, although Kansas City ’s collapse involved far more than one kick.

Asked about the attempt, Reid confessed he understood why his player pushed the ball right as he highlighted Denver ’s pressure and how the protection forced the kicker to adjust his approach, arguing those circumstances mattered when assessing the miss. “I could kind of see what he saw on that as far as he ended up going too far right,” Reid said. “But I see why he went right too. We never talk about the protection on that and the overloads on that, but you have a heavy overload on the left side and penetration there. That’s going to alter a kicker. “I mean, that’s just what you do as a kicker. It’s no different than what quarterbacks do when they’re throwing the football. So sometimes you have to alter the alignment there. So I get it. It just went a little bit too wide on it. But we’ve got to do a better job of that, of the protection for him.” Reid added: “He kind of had to kick it that way to avoid being blocked.”

Reid backs Butker as missed kicks mount

The kick came with Kansas City leading 24-21 and around two and a half minutes remaining as Butker missed wide right from 54 yards, giving Denver possession and the opportunity to complete a decisive scoring drive. Nix needed only two plays, finding rookie Jonah Coleman for a 51-yard reception before the running back scored on a five-yard run and the Broncos took its first lead since the opening quarter, moving ahead 28-24 with 1:56 remaining. Kansas City still reached the Denver one-yard line, but a false-start penalty erased an apparent touchdown pass to Rashee Rice and Malcolm Roach then sacked Patrick Mahomes on fourth down, sealing the result and leaving the Chiefs without a final response. Eyes are looking back to the kicker though as Butker converted 33 of 38 field goals in the 2025 regular season, an 86.8 percent success rate and through seven games in 2026, however, he had made only 12 of 18 attempts, leaving his accuracy at 66.7 percent. Those 11 missed field goals and five missed PAT attempts across the two regular seasons represent 38 potential points Kansas City has failed to collect – a vital load lost in what have been a series of competitive and tight games and the Chiefs have opted to act. The team signed veteran Justin Tucker to their practice squad in October after the Seattle Seahawks loss, creating competition at kicker although the special teams coordinator Dave Toub has nevertheless indicated the organization remains committed to helping Butker recover his form. The defeat dropped Kansas City to 5-2, while Denver improved to 6-2 and moved top of the division and puts the Chiefs under pressure in the AFC race. One thing that is clear: the team need better execution across as the season continues if they hope to win the Super Bowl .

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes desperately needs help, but Tyreek Hill may no longer be the answer for Chiefs
articles.standfirst: Kansas City is running out of solutions, but bringing back a familiar face may not be the move the team needs right now
articles.summary: Kansas City is running out of solutions, but bringing back a familiar face may not be the move the team needs right now
articles.body:
The season continues to move forward, and the paths of the Kansas City Chiefs and Tyreek Hill appear to be heading in opposite directions . Patrick Mahomes and the team are going through a difficult stretch, putting Hill back in the conversation as a potential asset who could help them turn things around .

After the loss to the Denver Broncos, Mahomes acknowledged that miscommunication between him, the receivers and the running backs had affected the team's execution . His comments reopened discussions about Hill, a former Chiefs star who remains available and has expressed interest in returning to football.

However, a reunion may not be the right move at this point. Kansas City cannot afford more mistakes if it wants to get back on the winning track, while Hill is coming off an injury that ended his season and effectively closed his chapter with the Miami Dolphins . The team has since moved toward younger options, including three drafted rookies: Caleb Douglas, Chris Bell and Kevin Coleman Jr., alongside Malik Washington, who is still developing.

The Chiefs already have options at receiver
